content.short: Paraswap is a DeFi aggregator that pools liquidity across multiple chains for seamless trading.
content.description: Founded in 2019, Paraswap is a leading DeFi aggregator that pools liquidity from lending protocols and DEXs to provide traders and dApps with high liquidity and instant transactions. It relies on robust APIs, advanced charts, multichain compatibility, on-chain RFQ, a yield optimizer, and independent smart contract audits. The Paraswap protocol currently supports BNB Chain, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, Fantom, Polygon, and Avalanche.

resources.title: How Large Trades Impact Your Execution (And How to Avoid It)
resources.tldr: Size moves the price against you before the trade even completes. Explains how splitting an order over time reduces slippage and where that stops helping.

resources.title: Guarded Swaps: Best Price Without the Fail Rate
resources.tldr: RFQ and proprietary AMM quotes are often the best price available and the first to expire between click and confirmation. On keeping the quote alive long enough to fill.

resources.title: The End of the Bridge: A Cross-Chain Execution Layer
resources.tldr: Argues the bridge should disappear behind execution rather than being a step the user performs. Covers hybrid execution, MEV protection and gasless flows.
